subject: Discrepancy in Results Between Previous and Current Analyses

messages.author: 425d8918bd154a2b
messages.subject: Discrepancy in Results Between Previous and Current Analyses
parts:
Hello,
I initially analysed the data several months ago and have recently repeated the analysis using the same dataset and models. However, I noticed notable discrepancies between the two analyses in terms of the model fit indices and parameter estimates, despite the sample size and degrees of freedom remaining identical. I was wondering whether these differences in the results could be attributable to the different versions of the `lavaan` package used for the analyses.

Thank you!
Best,
A

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Discrepancy in Results Between Previous and Current Analyses
parts:
You'll have to do the work to show us with a reprex.  You can find archived older versions of lavaan on CRAN.  Installing one version at a time (going backward in time) can help you discover the version change that led to different results.  Then you can read the version history to see if there are any clues.
